description: Find current House MPs by name, riding, province, or caucus. Set includeFormer for OpenParliament's historical name index; historical rows may contain only a name and slug. Follow nextOffset with identical filters and use detailLookup with canparl_get_member.

includeFormer.description: Use the sparse historical name index instead of the complete current official roster.

limit.description: Maximum rows, default 25, effective cap 100; values through 10000 are accepted and clamp with a notice. Whole records may end the page early at the 24000-byte response budget; follow nextOffset.

name.description: Current: literal name substring. Historical: one token is surname lookup; multiple tokens are full recorded name lookup, not substring search.

offset.description: Zero-based offset in the selected ordering.

party.description: Official caucus name; Bloc and Green aliases accepted; current roster only.

province.description: Province postal code or full English name; current roster only.

riding.description: Literal riding substring; current roster only.

name: canparl_search_members

appliedFilters.description: Normalized AND filters and name semantics.

cap.description: Effective page limit after the per-call cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unsupported_historical_filter`: Historical mode includes geographic or caucus filters. `invalid_member_filter`: Unknown province or current caucus. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

current.description: Current official roster membership, or null if unverified.

detailLookup.description: Pass exactly this identifier to canparl_get_member.

notice.description: Limit clamp, empty page, historical coverage, or response-budget guidance.

pagination.description: Continuation in the selected source ordering.

limit.description: Effective maximum rows after the per-call cap.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, or null when exhausted.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

total.description: Exact filtered current count; null for historical index.

totalCount.description: Exact filtered current roster count; absent for historical searches.

title: Canparl Search Members
